learning_objective: 🎯 Let us discover why the sun sets, why winter brings cold winds, and how animals know when it is time to sleep or fly away!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Our Earth is always spinning like a top! When your side of the Earth faces the sun, it is daytime, and when it spins away into the dark, it is nighttime.
As the Earth spins, it also slowly travels around the sun. This long journey brings us hot summers, rainy monsoons, and chilly winters!
Animals are very clever at changing with the seasons. Some birds fly far away to warmer places, while bears sleep peacefully through the entire cold winter.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Catch Your Shadow!
fun_activity.instructions: Stand outside in the bright morning sun and ask a friend to trace your shadow with chalk, then check again at noon to see how your shadow has magically changed size!

quick_recap: ⭐ The spinning of our Earth gives us the lovely rhythm of bright days and dark nights.
⭐ The Earth's year-long journey around the sun creates our beautiful changing seasons.
⭐ Animals have amazing ways to survive the changing weather, like migrating or hibernating.
